title: Venezuelan leader Maduro and wife indicted in New York on drug, terrorism charges
summary: The United States on Saturday announced terrorism and drugs charges against Venezulean President Nicolas Maduro, just hours after saying he had been captured and flown out of the country. The Venezuelan government demanded "immediate proof of life" of Maduro and his wife after a US "large-scale strike" rocked Caracas with explosions and aircraft-like sounds…
contentText: The United States on Saturday announced terrorism and drugs charges against Venezulean President Nicolas Maduro, just hours after saying he had been captured and flown out of the country. The Venezuelan government demanded "immediate proof of life" of Maduro and his wife after a US "large-scale strike" rocked Caracas with explosions and aircraft-like sounds. Washington Bureau Chief at The Guardian, David Smith, together with France24 journalist Shirli Sitbon, share their insights.
